description: Tracked keywords for one website: each pinned query's daily Search Console position (impression-weighted), clicks, impressions, top landing page, position_change against the prior window (positive moved up), ranking bucket (pos_1_3, pos_4_10, pos_11_20, pos_21_plus), and its drop alert. locked=true means the plan shows the queries without numbers. Same period/from/to/time_zone as analytics_snapshot.

from.description: inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 60 days

granularity.description: day, week, or month; default day

period.description: named window instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

name: tracked_keywords
title: Tracked keywords
